# External code

This directory contains code that is not part of the `g-p-atlas` package, but is useful for development.

## `tools_for_phen_gen_creation.py`

This is the original script used to generate the data used in the 'nonlinear phenotypes' publication.

It is an unmodified copy of the original script found here:
https://github.com/Arcadia-Science/accounting-for-nonlinear-phenotypes/blob/v1.0.1/01_code/python/tools_for_phen_gen_creation.py.

## `g_p_atlas.py`

This is the script used to define and train the G-P Atlas model used in the G-P Atlas pub.

It is an unmodified copy of the original script found here:
https://github.com/Arcadia-Science/2025-g-p-atlas/blob/v1.0.3/src/g-p_atlas_analysis_scripts/g_p_atlas.py.
